g.text: Stage II loss trajectories — validation components, training total only
Dashed vertical: selected checkpoint (full 6; frozen 4). Star: minimum logged loss. No smoothing.
Validation KD is plotted before its 0.1 weight; validation components are not a reconstructed training loss.
